scripts.build-js: bun build static/src/js/*.js --root static/src/js --outdir static/public/js --format iife --watch
scripts.build-js-prod: bun build static/src/js/*.js --root static/src/js --outdir static/public/js --format iife --minify
scripts.build: bun run build-css-prod && bun run build-js-prod
scripts.dev: bun run build-css && bun run build-js
scripts.sort-classes: docker compose exec formatter rustywind views/**/*.templ
scripts.sort-classes:write: docker compose exec formatter rustywind --write views/**/*.templ
scripts.sort-classes:check: docker compose exec formatter rustywind --check-formatted views/**/*.templ
